doc: Oracle records of the toy oracle machine (I12 fixture; format in the docstring of tests_m2/test_oracles.py). agg is a hash parameter whose concrete instance is the M1 aggregate stand-in; dec is an oracle parameter with two hypothesis variants of family HypD, each with its own concrete instance; fetcher is a not_in_scope record.

hypothesis.doc: CF(agg, S) for every finite S: agg maps the elements of S to pairwise different values. Each law states its own S.

instance.doc: the injective stand-in agg(xs) = AGG_BASE + enc(xs), the template of spec/M1/lib/morph_rollup.lib.json

hypothesis.doc: dec inverts the unpadded encodings of 1 and 2.
dec tolerates the padding: it inverts the encodings of 1 and 2 padded by PAD = 8.
the fetcher returns the data the chain committed

oracles.reason: the toy machine has no fetcher; the record exercises the not_in_scope form
